g.text: Site-average estimates and comparisons use the light-source-by-site interaction model.

text.style: font-size: 11.20px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-family: "Arial"; fill: #343C44;

g.text: Site rows are deviation ratios around each category estimate; parentheses show 95% confidence intervals.

text.style: font-size: 11.20px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-family: "Arial"; fill: #343C44;

g.text: Bold site ratios and FDR p-values pass the complete 53-member near-eye family; unsupported cells are not estimable.

text.style: font-size: 11.20px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-family: "Arial"; fill: #343C44;

g.text: Near-eye frame: 17,935 participant-hours; 140 participants; 801 participant-days; 9 sites.

text.style: font-size: 11.20px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-family: "Arial"; fill: #343C44;

g.text: Each participant-hour has one primary light-source category; 1/k multi-label weighting does not apply.

text.style: font-size: 11.20px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-family: "Arial"; fill: #343C44;

g.text: Panels A–C exclude site, participant, and participant-day smooths from displayed curves; panel D uses stored interaction-model estimands.

text.style: font-size: 11.20px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-family: "Arial"; fill: #343C44;

g.text: P, participants; D, participant-days; H, participant-hours. Country-coded labels and row order provide non-colour site cues.
